title.narrative: Healing and Reconciliation: Support to Societal Healing, Victim Care and Resilience Post-May 2023 Mass Shootings in Serbia

description.narrative: The majority of development services envisaged under this Agreement relate to support the healing process at societal and victim level after the mass shootings in May 2023. The services that will be provided by UNDP include set-up and administration of the Coordination Body, expert support for the establishment of a victim support mechanism, support for the annual commemorative event(s), support for planning of the memorial(s), and support for the establishment of a systemic integrated response to crisis and long-term support to victims of mass shootings.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
